note: EPM7064S ISP layout, derived by converting index-coded POFs with Quartus II 13.0 SP1 quartus_cpf (re/protocol.md, 2026-11-27). rows: the 55 programmed rows after the 88 product-term rows, in programming order; w016 / w01a: the 160-bit data words, 3 hex digits per bit (bit 0 first): fuse - 28160, or ffe / fff = constant 0 / 1. id_check: the silicon-ID reads (select loads and 32-bit reads with expected TDO and MASK).
